items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I worked with Woody Herman, you know, Maynard Ferguson, and Benny Goodman’s big bands.

ctx.x: Did you feel that that helped your overall technique and you were able to blend the two concepts?

Yeah to a certain degree, yeah, to a certain degree. Although, well it’s debatable about that, whether classical music helps your jazz or not. You know Benny Goodman played awful good before he ever took a lot of, studied a lot of classical music, so I’m not so sure that it really helps that much.
You talked about World War II. There is word that you were a prisoner of war.
